scope: Sheets relative-date controls and formula condition operands
changes: Date presets for today/tomorrow/yesterday, past week/month/year and exact dates.
Native relativeDate operands and formula operands derive filter visibility and value choices.
TODAY/NOW and relative filters share the controllable twin clock and spreadsheet time zone; quoted strings and sheet names remain intact.
Date-is windows use native custom formulas and reopen as their corresponding preset.

tests.contract_matrix: All four layers pass for Docs, Drive and Sheets, zero findings and unexpected 5xx.

flows: Before today reproduces the reference rows.
Past week reproduces the reference and survives reopen/reload.
Cancel a staged exact-date change preserves the past-week preset.
Switching a reopened preset to exact date starts with a clean input.
=TODAY() retains only Today; after yesterday retains Today and Tomorrow.
After-yesterday selection survives mobile reload; viewport/page both 390px.

limits: No claim of full Sheets or eight-provider parity.
Native provider readback was unavailable because gws credentials require reauthentication; reference outcomes were observed in Chrome.
Color filters, filter views, data-validation filtering, charts, protection, undo and broader coverage remain open.
